svg.title: Free-Stuff-Near-You — Sage FSNY mark, v4
svg.desc: The sage unified tag carries FSNY as a compact initial treatment. The face and broad lower local point share one uninterrupted contour and the same soft-green fill. The price tag and local point form one continuous outer path, with no separate pointer or visible seam. Original, unadopted concept; any lettering is editable.
